Financial Statements |website=jubilantfoodworks.com}} | assets_year = 2025 | equity = {{down}} {{INRConvert|2182|c}} | equity_year = 2025 | owner = | num_employees = 34,120 | num_employees_year = 2024 | parent = [[Jubilant Bhartia Group]] | divisions = | subsidiaries = {{ubl|Jubilant FoodWorks Lanka|Jubilant Golden Harvest|DP Eurasia NV (49.04%){{cite news |title=Jubilant Foodworks' WOS acquires additional 4.36% stake in DP Eurasia; stock gains ~1.5% |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/article/news-top-story/jubilant-foodworks-wos-acquires-additional-stake-in-dp-eurasia-stock-gains--122100600094_1.html |access-date=9 July 2023 |work=India Infoline |language=en}}}} | slogan = | footnotes = | website = {{URL|http://www.jubilantfoodworks.com/}} }} '''Jubilant FoodWorks Limited''' is an Indian [[food service]] company based in [[Noida]], which holds the [[master franchise]] for [[Domino's Pizza]] in [[India]], [[Nepal]], [[Sri Lanka]] and [[Bangladesh]], for [[Popeyes]] in India, Bangladesh, Nepal, and [[Bhutan]], and also for [[Dunkin' Donuts]] in India.[http://www.livemint.com/2011February24210743/Jubilant-FoodWorks-ties-up-wit.html] {{dead link|date=January 2019}} The company also operates two homegrown restaurant brands called Ekdum! and Hong's Kitchen. Jubilant FoodWorks is a part of the [[Jubilant Bhartia Group]], owned by Shyam Sunder Bhartia (husband of [[Shobhana Bhartia]]) and Hari Bhartia.{{cite web|url=http://www.jubl.com/jub-corp.html |title=Jubilant Life Sciences |website=Jubl.com |date=31 March 2013 |access-date=28 December 2013}} ==History== On the recommendation of a friend who owned other foreign pizza licences, Shyam Sunder Bhartia and Hari Bhartia of the [[Jubilant Bhartia Group]] entered into a master franchise partnership with [[Domino's Pizza]].{{cite web |last1=Shmavonian |first1=Karl |title=Pharma and Fast Food Fuel the Jubilant Bhartia Group |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbesasia/2012/10/24/pharma-and-fast-food-fuel-the-jubilant-bhartia-group/ |access-date=17 October 2021 |website=Forbes |language=en}} Domino's Pizza India Private Ltd. was incorporated on 16 March 1995, and began operations in 1996.{{cite web|url=http://www.jubilantfoodworks.com/ |title=Company - Jubilant FoodWorks Limited - JFL {{pipe}} The Company {{pipe}} Food Service Company {{pipe}} Jubilant FoodWorks Limited |publisher=Jubilant FoodWorks Ltd. |date=31 October 2013 |access-date=15 January 2014}} The company opened India's first Domino's Pizza outlet in [[New Delhi]] in 1996.{{cite web|url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/company-facts/jubilantfoodworks/history/JF04 |title=Company History of Jubilant Foodworks |website=Moneycontrol.com |access-date=28 December 2013}} The company changed its name to Jubilant FoodWorks Ltd in 2009. It was headed by Ajay Kaul since 2005. Pratik Rashmikant Pota became the CEO from April 2017.{{Cite news|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/food/jubilant-foodworks-names-pratik-pota-as-ceo-to-succeed-ajay-kaul/articleshow/56516375.cms|title=Jubilant FoodWorks names Pratik Pota as CEO; to succeed Ajay Kaul|last=Bhushan|first=Ratna|date=2017|newspaper=[[The Economic Times]]|access-date=2017-08-28}} Pota announced his resignation in March 2022 and stepped down in June.{{cite web |title=Pratik Pota resigns as CEO of Jubilant FoodWorks |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/pratik-pota-resigns-as-ceo-of-jubilant-foodworks-8221941.html |website=Moneycontrol |date=11 March 2022 |access-date=12 March 2022 |language=en}} On 24 February 2011, Jubilant FoodWorks signed a master franchise agreement with American coffeehouse chain [[Dunkin' Donuts]] to operate the brand in India.{{cite web|author=Rasul Bailay |url=http://www.livemint.com/2011/02/24210743/Jubilant-FoodWorks-ties-up-wit.html |title=Jubilant FoodWorks ties up with Dunkin |website=Livemint.com |date=24 February 2011 |access-date=28 December 2013}} Jubilant FoodWorks opened India's first Dunkin' Donuts outlet in [[Connaught Place, New Delhi|Connaught Place]], New Delhi in April 2012.{{cite web|last=Kretzmann |first=David |url=http://www.fool.com/investing/general/2013/12/21/how-dominos-is-poised-to-benefit-from-india.aspx |title=How Domino's Is Poised to Benefit From India |website=Fool.com |date=21 December 2013 |access-date=15 January 2014}}{{cite web |url=http://www.nextiphonenews.com/2013/12/how-dominos-pizza-inc-dpz-is-poised-to-benefit-from-india/ |title=How Domino's Pizza, Inc. (DPZ) Is Poised to Benefit From India |publisher=Next iPhone News |date=21 December 2013 |access-date=15 January 2014 |archive-date=7 January 2014 March 2021 |date=24 March 2021}} The company opened India's first Popeyes outlet at [[Koramangala]], [[Bangalore]] on 20 January 2022. Jubilant FoodWorks suffered a security breach in April 2021 and hackers reportedly obtained 13 terabytes of data including 180 million order details, customer names, phone numbers, email IDs, addresses, payment details, and at least 1 million credit cards.{{cite web |title=Domino's Pizza hack in India: What details were stolen and what happens next |url=https://www.wionews.com/india-news/dominos-pizza-hack-in-india-what-details-were-stolen-and-what-happens-next-378882 |website=WION |access-date=24 September 2021 |language=en}} ===Acquisitions=== On 1 January 2021, Jubilant FoodWorks purchased a 10.76% stake in [[Barbeque Nation]] for {{INRConvert|92|c}}.{{cite web |title=Jubilant continues to broaden its food service scope; buys 10.76% stake in Barbeque Nation |url=https://www.timesnownews.com/business-economy/companies/article/jubilant-continues-to-broaden-its-food-service-scope-buys-10-76-stake-in-barbeque-nation/701628 |website=www.timesnownews.com}} The company acquired a 35% stake in Mumbai-based food tech startup Thrive for {{INRConvert|24.75|c}} in October 2021.{{Cite news |last=Bhushan |first=Ratna |title=JFL to acquire stake in Thrive platform Hashtag Loyalty |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/food/jfl-to-acquire-stake-in-thrive-platform-hashtag-loyalty/articleshow/87316745.cms |access-date=2022-05-14}} On 19 February 2021, the company announced that it would acquire complete ownership of Netherlands-based Fides Food Systems Coöperatief UA for [[£]]24.80 million through its subsidiary Jubilant Foodworks Netherlands BV. Fides held a 32.81% stake in DP Eurasia NV, which is the master franchisee for Dominos Pizza in Turkey, Russia, Azerbaijan and Georgia.{{cite news |last1=Bhushan |first1=Ratna |title=Jubilant |access-date=2022-03-12}} ==Domino's Pizza== ===India=== The first Domino's Pizza in India opened in [[New Delhi]] in January 1996. India surpassed the United Kingdom to become Domino's second-largest market in December 2014, behind the United States.{{cite web|last=Kretzmann |first=David |url=http://www.fool.com/investing/general/2013/12/21/how-dominos-is-poised-to-benefit-from-india.aspx |title=How Domino's Is Poised to Benefit From India |website=Fool.com |date=21 December 2013 |access-date=28 December 2013}}{{cite web |url=http://www.nextiphonenews.com/2013/12/how-dominos-pizza-inc-dpz-is-poised-to-benefit-from-india/ |title=How Domino's Pizza, Inc. web|url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/xrI7jynz4qNIbLyHdxaaLK/Pizza-Hut-to-open-100-outlets-in-India-to-counter-competitio.html|title=Pizza Hut to open 100 outlets in India to counter competition|first=Suneera|last=Tandon|date=3 February 2015|website=Livemint.com/|access-date=8 January 2019}} Domino's Pizza operates 1,995 stores across 421 Indian cities as of September 2024.{{Cite web |title=Company Profile |url=https://www.jubilantfoodworks.com/about-us/company-profile |access-date=2024-09-14 |website=www.jubilantfoodworks.com}} Domino's began accepting online orders in 2011, and online orders accounted for approximately 18-20% of total sales by December 2013.{{cite web|last=Kretzmann |first=David |url=http://www.dailyfinance.com/2013/12/10/why-dominos-digital-component-is-important/?source=edddlftxt0860001 |title=Why Domino's Digital Component Is Important |website=DailyFinance.com |access-date=28 December 2013}} On 19 March 2014, the 700th Domino's Pizza outlet was opened at [[HUDA City Centre metro station]] in Sector-29, [[Gurgaon|Gurugram]], [[Haryana]].{{cite web|url=http://www.jubilantfoodworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/Press-Release_Dominos-crosses-700th-restaurant-mark-milestone1.pdf|title=Domino's Pizza celebrates another milestone with the opening of its 700th Restaurant in India!|website=Jubilantfoodworks.com|access-date=8 January 2019|archive-date=14 July 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190714202454/http://www.jubilantfoodworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/Press-Release_Dominos-crosses-700th-restaurant-mark-milestone1.pdf|url-status=dead}} The company opened 47 new restaurants between January–March 2014 and 150 outlets in the 2013–2014 [[Fiscal year|financial year]].{{cite web |title=Press Release -Financial Results for Q3 & 9MFY2020 |url=https://www.jubilantfoodworks.com/Uploads/Files/480akmfile-Q39MFY20PressReleaseFinal.pdf |access-date=11 April 2020 |website=Jubilantfoodworks.com}} Domino's opened its 1000th outlet at Unity One Mall, Janakpuri, Delhi in January 2016.{{Cite press release|last=Pizza|first=Domino's|title=Domino's® Opens 1,000th Store in India|url=https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/dominos-opens-1000th-store-in-india-300216406.html|access-date=2021-11-15|website=www.prnewswire.com|language=en}} In May 2016, the [[Centre for Science and Environment]] (CSE) reported that Domino's pizza bread was laced with toxins and carcinogens such as [[potassium bromate]] and [[potassium iodate]]. Potassium bromate is a category 2B carcinogen, meaning it can cause cancer.{{cite web|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/current-affairs/kfc-pizza-hut-domino-s-mcdonald-s-outlets-selling-toxic-breads-cse-study-116052301620_1.html|title=KFC, Pizza Hut, Domino's, McDonald's outlets selling toxic breads: CSE study|first=Deepak|last=Patel|date=24 May 2016|access-date=8 January 2019|newspaper=[[Business Standard]]}} Potassium bromate was banned in India in June 2016.{{Cite web |agency=PTI|date=Jun 21, 2016 |title=India bans use of cancer-causing additive, potassium bromate, in bread, other food {{!}} India News - Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/india-bans-use-of-cancer-causing-additive-potassium-bromate-in-bread-other-food/articleshow/52836892.cms |access-date=2022-03-12 |website=The Times of India |language=en}} In 2017, a customer in Delhi claimed to have found live bugs in Domino's Pizza seasoning sachets. A video of the same went viral.{{cite web|url=https://indianexpress.com/article/trending/trending-in-india/dominos-pizzas-live-bugs-in-seasoning-packet-man-posts-video/|title=WATCH: Delhi man finds live bugs in Domino's Pizza seasoning sachet; video goes viral|date=12 September 2017|website=Indianexpress.com|access-date=8 January 2019}} This prompted Domino's to stop giving seasoning sachets for some time. When they restarted, they changed the packing from transparent to opaque. Jubilant Golden Harvest Ltd. was established in early 2019 with Jubilant holding a 51% stake, and Bangladeshi company Golden Harvest Group holding the remaining 49%.{{Cite news |agency=Press Trust of India |date=2019-03-15 |title=Jubilant FoodWorks enters Bangladesh market through JV with local partner |work=Business Standard India |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/jubilant-foodworks-enters-bangladesh-market-119031501042_1.html |access-date=2022-03-12}} The first Domino's Pizza outlet opened in [[Dhaka]] in February 2019.{{cite web |title=Domino's vows to be top pizza chain in Bangladesh |url=https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/dhaka/2019/03/15/domino-s-pizza-vows-to-be-top-pizza-chain-in-bangladesh |website=Dhaka Tribune |access-date=15 November 2021 |date=15 March 2019}}{{cite web |title=Jubilant FoodWorks gains with Domino's Pizza witnessing record number of orders in Dhaka |url=https://udaipurkiran.com/jubilant-foodworks-gains-with-dominos-pizza-witnessing-record-number-of-orders-in-dhaka/ |website=Udaipur News |access-date=19 April 2019 |date=25 March 2019}} In September 2021, Jubilant FoodWorks exercised its first [[call option]] to acquire an additional 39% stake in the joint venture taking its ownership to 90%.{{Cite news |title=JFL to acquire Golden Harvest's remaining 10% stake in Jubilant Golden Harvest JV |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/food/jfl-to-acquire-golden-harvests-remaining-10-stake-in-jubilant-golden-harvest-jv/articleshow/90376157.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2022-05-14}} Jubilant FoodWorks exercised its second call option to acquire the remaining 10% stake and took complete control of the joint venture in May 2022. The cost of the two call options to acquire the 49% stake was BD{{BDTConvert|38.90|c}}. One share in Jubilant Golden Harvest remains with a company nominee in order to comply with Bangladeshi regulations.{{Cite news |last=Market |first=Capital |date=2022-05-11 |title=Jubilant FoodWorks completes acquisition of balance 49% stake in Jubilant Golden Harvest |work=Business Standard India |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/jubilant-foodworks-completes-acquisition-of-balance-49-stake-in-jubilant-golden-harvest-122051100767_1.html |access-date=2022-05-14}} There are currently 44 Domino's Pizza outlets in Bangladesh.{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/285966295381697/posts/632669817378008|title=We are very delighted to announce that our dining is open again!|work=Domino's Pizza Bangladesh on Facebook|access-date=21 August 2020}}{{better source needed|reason=social media|date=June 2026}} ===Sri Lanka=== Jubilant FoodWorks Lanka Pvt. Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Jubilant FoodWorks, operates Domino's Pizza outlets in Sri Lanka. The first Domino's outlet opened in [[Colombo]] in February 2011.{{cite web |title=First Domino's Pizza outlet opens in Colombo - Indian Express |url=http://archive.indianexpress.com/news/first-dominos-pizza-outlet-opens-in-colombo/841083/ |website=archive.indianexpress.com |access-date=15 November 2021}} There were 23 Domino's Pizza outlets in Sri Lanka as of December 2017.{{cite web|title=Domino's opens outlet in Boralesgamuwa|url=http://www.dailymirror.lk/article/Domino-s-opens-outlet-in-Boralesgamuwa-122930.html|website=Daily Mirror|access-date=9 November 2017|language=en}} ==Dunkin' Donuts== On 24 February 2011, Jubilant FoodWorks signed a master franchise agreement with American coffeehouse chain [[Dunkin' Donuts]] to operate the brand in India. Jubilant FoodWorks opened India's first Dunkin' Donuts outlet in [[Connaught Place, New Delhi|Connaught Place]], New Delhi in April 2012. Apart from donuts, [[Doughnut hole|Munchkins]], and coffee, the chain also serves vegetarian and non-vegetarian hot and cold food.{{cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/panache/delights-for-tough-guys-vegetarians/articleshow/35144116.cms|title=Delights for tough guys & vegetarians|date=15 May 2014|access-date=8 January 2019|newspaper=[[The Economic Times]]}} Jubilant FoodWorks operates 21 Dunkin' Donuts outlets across 6 Indian cities as of 30 June 2023.{{Cite web |title=Dunkin' |url=https://www.jubilantfoodworks.com/brands/dunkin-donuts |access-date=2024-09-14 |website=www.jubilantfoodworks.com}} == Popeyes == On 24 March 2021, Jubilant FoodWorks entered into a master franchise and development agreement with [[Restaurant Brands International]] to operate [[Popeyes]] restaurants in India, Bangladesh, Nepal and Bhutan. The company opened India's first Popeyes outlet at [[Koramangala]], [[Bangalore]] on 20 January 2022.{{Cite web |title=Popeyes® Brand Arrives in India as Part of Continued International Growth |url=https://www.businesswireindia.com/popeyes-brand-arrives-in-india-as-part-of-continued-international-growth-76946.html |access-date=2022-03-12 |website=www.businesswireindia.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |last=Livemint |date=2022-01-19 |title=Jubilant Foodworks opens first Popeyes outlet in Bengaluru |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/jubilant-foodworks-opens-first-popeyes-outlet-in-bengaluru-11642569324287.html |access-date=2022-03-12 |website=mint |language=en}} ==Other brands== ===Hong's Kitchen=== Jubilant FoodWorks launched its first homegrown brand called Hong's Kitchen, offering fast casual Chinese dining, with the first restaurant opening in Gurugram on 13 March 2019. ===Ekdum!=== Jubilant FoodWorks launched its second homegrown brand called Ekdum!, offering a variety of biryanis from across India in addition to kebabs, curries, breads, desserts and beverages. The first three Ekdum! restaurants were opened in [[Gurgaon|Gurugram]], Haryana in December 2020.{{cite web |last1=Tandon |first1=Suneera |title=Jubilant FoodWorks forays into biryani business with 'Ekdum' |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/jubilant-foodworks-forays-into-biryani-brand-ekdum-11608126898411.html |website=mint |access-date=15 November 2021 |language=en |date=16 December 2020}}{{cite web |title=Jubilant FoodWorks makes foray into Biryani segment with brand 'Ekdum!' |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/business/companies/jubilant-foodworks-makes-foray-into-biryani-segment-with-brand-ekdum-7108429/ |website=The Indian Express |access-date=15 November 2021 |language=en |date=17 December 2020}} ===ChefBoss=== In August 2020, Jubilant FoodWorks launched its ChefBoss, a brand of ready-to-cook sauces, gravies and pastes.{{cite web |date=6 August 2020 |title=Jubilant FoodWorks enters the FMCG market with ChefBoss |url=https://www.livemint.com/industry/retail/jubilant-foodworks-enters-the-fmcg-market-with-chefboss-11596716763422.html |access-date=6 August 2020 |website=Mint |language=en}} == References == {{Reflist|30em}} == External links == {{commons category|Domino's Pizza in India}} * {{official website|http://www.jubilantfoodworks.com/}} {{portalbar|Companies}} {{Domino's Pizza}} {{Pizza chains|state=autocollapse}} {{Nifty 200 companies}} [[Category:Companies based in Noida]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1995]] [[Category:Domino's]] [[Category:Pizza chains of India]] [[Category:Coffeehouses and cafés in India]] [[Category:Bakeries of India]] [[Category:1995 establishments in Uttar Pradesh]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
extract: Jubilant FoodWorks Limited  is an Indian food service company based in Noida, which holds the master franchise for Domino's Pizza in India, Nepal, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh, for Popeyes in India, Bangladesh, Nepal, and Bhutan, and also for Dunkin' Donuts in India. The company also operates two homegrown restaurant brands called Ekdum! and Hong's Kitchen. Jubilant FoodWorks is a part of the Jubilant Bhartia Group, owned by Shyam Sunder Bhartia (husband of Shobhana Bhartia) and Hari Bhartia.
